# Barrera Wallpaper

Barrera Wallpaper is a Miami-based premium wall coverings company founded by Oscar Barrera. We specialize in the sale and professional installation of high-end wallpaper for residential and commercial spaces.

## What We Do

- **Premium Wallpaper Sales**: Curated collection of luxury wallpapers including SYSTEXX German-engineered glass fiber textiles
- **Professional Installation**: Certified installation services for residential and commercial projects in Miami, Florida and across the USA
- **Custom Wallpaper Design**: AI-powered wallpaper generation and custom design consultation with Oscar Barrera
- **SYSTEXX Technology**: Glass fiber wall coverings with A2 fire protection, magnetic surfaces, acoustic comfort, and extreme durability
